kernel_case: cases/test46 (source.mcm 20,470,080 B + target.mcm 7,031,334 B identical to the run's MPS pair, plus mi-forward/, mi-reverse/, lp-only/, bundle.json, and combined-attempt.rpa)
reformulation: Table/marginal reformulation of a 12-node 78-table protein-design model: delete the 80,785 selectors whose cost 39,424 exceeds the objective upper bound 39,423 and the 17,234 selectors of 17 complete Cartesian cost-17 pair factors (constant objective shift 289), drop 90 index/cost helpers and 288 old rows, replace p_lin_0's RHS 0 by 289, relax the 60,608 retained pair selectors and objective to continuous, and add 3,602 full state-marginal rows. Source 159,145 vars / 301 equalities -> target 61,036 vars / 3,615 equalities; integer variables 159,145 -> 427.
claim_class: Retained-coordinate projection equality in both MI directions plus target-LP-to-source-LP inclusion, all with exact objective equality, delivered as three separately verified complete claims over one source/target MCM pair. No strict-LP, optimum, global-feasibility or bijection claim.
claims: Direction 0 (mi-forward): reverse=false, input_integers=true, output_integers=true, objective=Equal, 61,036 projection pairs; every source-MI point maps to the target with all retained coordinates and the objective preserved. 187,150 obligations, work 391,209,842, branches 18,010.

Direction 1 (mi-reverse): reverse=true, input_integers=true, output_integers=true, objective=Equal, 61,036 pairs; every target-MI point lifts to a source-MI point, carrying 60,608 continuous-pair integrality proofs and one joint IntervalLift of 17,234 AND entries. 538,773 obligations, work 152,443,790, branches 78,937.

Direction 2 (lp-only): reverse=true, input_integers=false, output_integers=false, objective=Equal, 61,036 pairs; target-LP-to-source-LP inclusion via 17 four-corner interval couplings, one per deleted constant table. 379,628 obligations, work 7,424,119.

bundle.json pins all three claims to one source SHA-256 and one target SHA-256 and states 'no single direction represents the whole contract' (cases/test46/bundle.json:200); the three requests are the natural one-request statement 3x 861,798 B, while the merged RPA cannot assemble.

Boundary receipts: directions 0 and 1 return RESOURCE_LIMIT (exit 3) at the former 100,000,000 work policy, direction 2 verifies there (exit 0); all three VERIFIED at 1,000,000,000 (cases/test46/bundle.json:56, :118, :180).
proof_encoding: Three RPA 5 texts (183,934,850 B / 234,499,424 B / 14,451,698 B), each 'RPA 5\n' + {claims:[1 claim], blocks:[1 block]}; assembled RPX 184,634,642 B / 156,755,175 B / 10,275,133 B (bundle.json artifact hashes).

The author merged them by byte surgery: each part's tail after '"blocks":[' is copied and its header plus claim copy dropped (tools/finalize_test46.py:15-20); the 432,885,912 B result is preserved as combined-attempt.rpa after assemble returns RESOURCE_LIMIT 'RPA bytes' (tools/finalize_test46.py:27-31).

Root cases/test46/request.json is the concatenation of the three one-claim request files (combined-request.json 2,585,390 B), i.e. the whole contract is statable in one request but not assemblable in one certificate.

Steps are hand-emitted raw JSON dicts: Lin (tools/prepare_test46.py:25), EqPair (:34), Cases (:42), Round (tools/prepare_test46_full.py:10-12), Drop (:140-144); each reverse part wraps its body in one IntervalLift.

Scale: 344,878 root steps for mi-forward (mi-forward/preparation.json:6-11) and 738,622 for mi-reverse (:6-11); 1,105,551 obligations and 96,947 branches over the three replays; peak 344,878 live facts.
agent_manual_work: Exact free-format parse of the 29.5 MB MPS (Fraction tokens, INTORG/INTEND covering all 159,145 variables, single RHS1/BND1 sets, UP bounds only) and classification of all 301 rows and 159,145 columns into 12 unary + 66 complete 49x49 pair tables whose endpoint graph is K12.

Proved the forbidden-entry argument by hand: cost 39,424 > objective upper bound 39,423 with nonnegative costs, hence all 80,785 such selectors are zero, then wrote the balanced nonnegative sum tree and its integer rounding explicitly.

Recorded the exact local counterexample (factor p_lin_49, endpoints (21,37) matched by half-weight (20,37)+(22,37) at 15/19 vs integral 19) that refutes dropping pair integrality under index moments alone, and enumerated 83,268 endpoint combinations (77,842 allowed / 5,426 forbidden).

Wrote output/reformulated.mps (9,397,171 B) with a hand-rolled MPS emitter, then re-read it with a second independent Decimal state machine (audit.json 8,689,830 B, verification.json) - the target and its audit were produced with no kernel API.

Authored six RPA mutants by locating steps by index in the proof tree (a Round step's integer ref, obligation 122498+12, intervals[8000].checks[2], a constant 17 -> 18, a perturbed LP corner) and required assemble+verify INVALID for each.

tools/oracle_test46.py (53 lines) produced oracle.json: 10,657 independent Fraction checks (onehot_pairs 1,015; integer_marginal_tables 834; lp_interval_couplings 8,748; cost_cutoff 60) on generalized domains, explicitly not a substitute for the actual-model obligations.
friction: The delivery format is set by a byte budget, not by mathematics: one merged certificate exceeds the 256 MiB RPA parser limit, so the case is three part texts plus a manifest, and the only kernel answer for a bundle is RESOURCE_LIMIT - nothing can assemble or verify parts as one contract.

Every proof step is a hand-written dict with hand-rolled precondition asserts (Proof.lin/eqpair/check/cases), so the coupling lemmas the case needs - two-sequence uniqueness, AND-of-two-binaries, grouped negative trees, four-corner interval couplings - were re-invented inside the case preparer.

Homogeneous families are expanded instance by instance: 3,602 marginal rows and 60,608 integrality proofs are written out one by one, leaving 183.9 MB and 234.5 MB texts 10-40 percent under the parser ceiling, while docs/CURRENT_FORMAT.md:380 states batch records are not implemented.

Contract scope is discovered by running: the 100,000,000-work RESOURCE_LIMIT of both MI directions and the 256 MiB refusal were found by executing and then re-run as receipts; no preflight reports work, live facts or bytes before a certificate is written.

Target/claim binding is manual: the preparer rebuilds every expected target variable (tools/prepare_test46.py:100) and row (:115) from the analysis agent's audit.json hints and asserts equality with the delivered MCM, because there is no edit-apply/audit API.
notes: This is the canonical MULTI_PART_ASSEMBLY case: the mathematical work (Lin/Round/Cases/IntervalLift) succeeds, the packaging does not. The API must make 'one contract, several files' first-class - parts bound to one source/target hash pair, an explicit all-parts-must-pass verdict, and block-streaming assembly so the 256 MiB text budget applies per part instead of to a merged 432,885,912 B text. Two further observations for the compiler: (a) the three parts differ only in claim mode (MI forward, MI reverse, LP reverse) and in which two of the three block families are emitted, so a mode parameter over one plan would remove most hand editing; (b) both parts that reach the byte ceiling are dominated by instance-wise expansions of two homogeneous families, so BATCH_TEMPLATES is also the cheapest relief for the submission budget.
